description: A byte that isn't valid UTF-8 in a string becomes U+FFFD
notes: RFC 7159, which the spec adopts as its grammar, says JSON text is Unicode encoded in UTF-8, UTF-16 or UTF-32, so a byte sequence that isn't valid UTF-8 isn't JSON text, and the spec doesn't say what to do with it. hashicorp/hcl decodes strings with Go's encoding/json (parseString in json/parser.go), which replaces each invalid byte with U+FFFD REPLACEMENT CHARACTER.
